== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|The Lightcaster IV is a widely available [[plasma pistol]] used throughout the galaxy. Known for its versatility, the weapon's marketing emphasizes that it functions in any environment, including vacuums where standard [[plasma]] pistols often fail. It is a type of [[Aethertech]] that can be used by various individuals, including soldiers in powered armor or those facing magical defenses. While it is a common sidearm, it can be modified with enchantments to multiply its fire rate or used in conjunction with other magical tools. The Lightcaster line includes heavier variations, such as the [[Suncaster L-14]] heavy [[plasma]] [[launcher construct|launcher]] and the [[Lightcaster Heavy II]], which is specifically designed for use by [[Karoshan|Karoshans]] and [[Union]] soldiers.}}

== The Captain ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-01-the-captain|The Lightcaster IV is a [[plasma pistol]] capable of functioning within any atmosphere. This weapon fires shots, which [[Varic Vallenar|Varic]] utilizes to shoot bolts. The Captain also employs a Lightcaster to cast protective barriers. Additionally, the narrator keeps a Lightcaster concealed within a warded pocket.}}
